summary: Frontend-only testing of Restaurants Galore Phase 1. All 12 test scenarios PASSED. Header button renders, dashboard opens with 4 empty-state KPI cards and all 18 launcher tiles (only Directory active). Directory CRUD verified: add, favorite toggle + filter, edit with correct prefill (name/nickname/phone all intact), delete-with-cascade confirm dialog, and reload persistence via localforage (rg_restaurants). Tile Packs shows 'Restaurants Galore™' as the first pack with the correct tagline. All prior header buttons still present (meal-planner, pantry, barcode, trip-journal). No console errors.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — the edit modal and the delete-confirm AlertDialog lack DialogDescription. Non-blocking but should be added for accessibility parity with the Dashboard/Directory modals.

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Add a DialogDescription to RestaurantEditModal in /app/frontend/src/notes/RestaurantDirectoryModal.jsx to eliminate the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: restaurantsService.deleteRestaurant iterates all 6 auxiliary stores sequentially for cascade delete — fine for MVP but O(N·stores). Consider indexing by restaurant_id when volumes grow.
RestaurantDirectoryModal.jsx is ~480 lines and includes the Edit sub-modal + Field helper in the same file. Fine now but consider splitting once more workspaces are added.
computeDashboardStats sorts orders in place (orders.sort) which mutates the array returned from iterate; not causing bugs since it's a fresh array, but prefer .slice().sort() to be safe.
seed_data_creation: One 'Persistence Test' restaurant was left in localforage after the reload test. It is a per-browser artifact and does not affect other users/environments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Restaurants Galore Phase 1 is stable end-to-end. Only Directory is wired; other 17 launcher tiles are intentionally disabled with 'Coming soon' — do not flag as bug. FirstRunTour dismiss = click [data-testid=tour-skip]. Storage is 100% offline via localforage under DB 'IronRabbit', storeName prefix 'rg_'.
